notes.title: New Release OUT NOW - Wisdom Watcher
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44475093/1d934928ad5a783ac768a761265378bc3f0d379d.png[/img]

Get on board Watchers!🔥  
Today is the day, the [b]NEW RELEASE[/b] of Wisdom Watcher is [b]OUT NOW[/b]!  
Join the battle with us, are you ready to break the current wave record?  ⚔️ 


👉 [b]THIS NEW PATCH IS A TOTAL GAME UPGRADE. HERE ARE THE NOVELTIES[/b]: 

[list]
[*] Introduced an introductory mode that allows you to discover the game progressively.
[*] Added a robotic assistant, L.O.O.P.., who will guide you through the watcher's story and the discovery of the game.
[*] General graphic revamp, with a brand new interactive Hub.
[*] Increased the Waves, the normal mode now has 20 waves, while the hard mode has a staggering 80.
[*] Introduced shields and rebalanced melee combat.
[*] Trap construction has been simplified.
[*] Modified interaction with tip signs.
[*] Added various weak points at specific points on enemies.
[*] Mana and health crystals introduced instead of insects and potions.
[*] General combat balancing.
[*] Renewed enemy AI.
[*] Keep following us, the game is constantly growing! Go, Watchers, unleash hell!
[/list]

Wisdom Watcher continues to evolve with ongoing development, and to ensure the title perseveres to accommodate all users, community feedback is crucial and always appreciated. To reach out to the Space Whale development team directly, you can access the Discord server to become a game tester, or to express opinions.


🎮 Get ready for an unprecedented VR experience, where every victory will bring you closer to salvation... or eternal imprisonment.

notes.title: New patch 1.0.19 now available!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44475093/40471a3cb3538e7c67d214c93c86b2ffad10f778.png[/img]

Welcome to our latest weekly patch! We're excited to bring you some new updates:

[list][*] [b]Introducing Hard Mode:[/b] Brace yourselves for a more challenging experience with our new Hard Mode! Expect tougher, more complex waves. Note that Normal and Hard modes will now have separate ranking scores.[/list]
[list][*] [b]Damage Points Visibility:[/b] Players can now see the damage points inflicted when attacking mobs.[/list]
[list][*] [b]Tummà's Rocks: [/b]Rocks thrown by Tummà can now be shattered by shooting at them.[/list]
[list][*] [b]Gun Functionality:[/b] Fixed an issue where a gun would stop working during waves.[/list]
[list][*] [b]Bauk's Behavior: [/b]Corrected the behavior of Bauk to ensure it consistently reacts to the player.[/list]

We're committed to continuously improving your gaming experience. Don't forget to [url=https://discord.gg/bCVKz57hMe]join our Discord server[/url]  to share your feedback and suggestions!

notes.title: Patch 1.0.16
notes.notes:
Welcome to our new weekly patch! We have some spicy updates this week:

[list]
[*] [b]New Mob Alert![/b] Keep an eye out for the stone-throwing Tummà – a new challenge awaits!
[*] [b]Hell's Gate Update:[/b] We've fine-tuned the difficulty for the first 10 waves and added new challenges with waves 51 to 70. Moreover, stones thrown by the Bauk can now be destroyed.
[*] [b]Combat Timing Adjustments:[/b] Melee attack timings from mobs have been optimized for a smoother fighting experience.
[*] [b]Bug Fixes & Enhancements:[/b] Various bugs have been squashed, including improvements to the VFX for Tesla Coils.
[/list]

And remember to [url=https://discord.gg/bCVKz57hMe]join our Discord server[/url]  if you want to provide us with feedback about the game and help us make it better!

notes.title: New patch
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44475093/5d946995f2ef3dd3192008fccf315db204df74cb.jpg[/img]

First Patch After the Early Access Release!
Thanks to the invaluable feedback we've received in the first few days (if you'd like to contribute to the game's future development, please join [url=https://discord.gg/bCVKz57hMe] our Discord server[/url]), we're excited to release a patch today with several updates:

[list]
[*][b] New Cards![/b] Introducing three Bauk cards, each featuring a unique passive ability.
[*] [b]Armored Tummà Mobs[/b]: now appearing in Hell's Gate.
[*][b] Language Selection: [/b]choose between English or Italian when you first launch the game.
[*] [b]Shotgun Update: [/b]now automatic and doesn't require reloading.
[*][b] Melee Combat Improvement:[/b] inflicting damage using melee weapons has been improved and made it easier to handle (no full swing at full force is needed to hit the mobs now)
[*] [b]Explosive Barrels:[/b] can now trigger nearby barrels to explode - how about a big chain explosion?
[*] [b]Bug Fixes:[/b] we've smashed lots of bugs for a smoother gameplay experience!
[/list]

notes.title: New demo patch!
notes.notes:
[u][b]Major Updates:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] new intro arena Colosseum for quick tutorial
[*] removed guns reload and added continuous bullet flow using mana
[*]movement system upgraded
[*] added ranged core absorption feature
[*] added ranged multi core absorption feature
[*] removed stagger of enemies
[*] fix of the swing and damage of melee weapons
[/list]

[u][b]Minor updates:[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] automatic chest opening once the player run near by
[*] settings menu on central overlay
[*] Kalafak explosion time reduced
[*] fix firearm recoil
[*] added version number of the game in the settings menu
[/list]

Now available a [b]new introduction arena[/b] with a big spoiler of something coming…you should play to find out, we want to keep it secret! You will now be introduced to the gameplay with various tips and tricks before joining the hub.
The [b]old tutorial with more in depth instruction will remain available[/b] anytime through the main room of the hub, so don’t worry if you’ll miss some instructions while playing the intro. 

We also [b]updated the overall gameplay[/b], introducing new functions like the opportunity to [b]absorb the core [/b]like the players did with the mana potions, and you will be able to [b]absorb many of them  using the same long grab input[/b].

Even the [b]melee weapons are now improved[/b], if you execute a good swing you’ll be able to gain the same points like shooting with a gun.

[b]Running it’s way easier[/b] than before, and you can grab and throw the [b]Kalafak with an explosion time reduced[/b], so be quick and don’t waste time!

And talking about time… you can now see all the [b]chests opening automatically while you pass near them[/b], in this way you’ll be able to grab the weapon without being an easy target for monster.!
We know our monsters are kinda…aggressive maybe? But don’t worry, this time we [b]removed the guns reload system[/b], so now you’ll be free to shoot with continuous flow through your mana. But don’t forget to recharge it! You are still human eheh.

And just a small tip before starting your new adventure: we[b] added the version number of the game in the settings menu[/b]! In this way you can keep us updated through your feedback while fast checking on the version you are currently playing!

As always, we are looking for your opinions and feedback! [url=https://discord.com/invite/S2fqJYGGDg]Join our Discord server [/url]and let us know what you think!
Start your engine and may the best Wisdom Watcher win!

[*] monsters will no more have active colliders after death to avoid situations where the player remain stuck due to too many mob dead bodies around him
[*] added fx in the hub area to make tutorial and battle arena more evident
[*] added smooth turning option on the settings menu (be aware that it may cause motion sickness)
[*] fixed and raised drop rate of rare and epic cards
[/list]
